title: Backend Developer
job_description:
Diploma / Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field 2-3 years of working experience in PHP development Solid understanding of PHP framework. Hands-on experience with Laravel framework Experience using MySQL or other relational databases Basic knowledge of JavaScript , HTML, CSS Familiar with RESTful APIs and basic API integration Experience with Git or other version control systems Willingness to learn, responsible, and able to work independently with guidance Added Advantages (Nice to Have) Experience with Redis or caching mechanisms Exposure to queue systems (e.g. Laravel Queue) Understanding of basic web security practices Experience working on high-traffic or transaction-based systems Language Requirements Proficiency in Mandarin (spoken and written) to collaborate with Mandarin-speaking internal stakeholders and technical documentation Good command of English Basic knowledge of Bahasa Malaysia is an added advantage

Job Overview MDvelop Technology Sdn Bhd is looking for a motivated PHP Developer with 2-3 years of hands-on experience to support the development and maintenance of web-based systems. This role is suitable for a developer who has a solid foundation in PHP and Laravel, is eager to learn, and enjoys working in a fast-paced technical environment. You will work closely with senior developers to enhance existing systems, build new features, and ensure system stability and performance. Key Responsibilities Assist in developing and maintaining web applications using PHP and Laravel framework Write clean, structured, and maintainable code following development best practices Support backend development tasks including feature implementation and bug fixing Work with databases to create, optimize, and maintain queries Assist in integrating internal and third-party APIs Perform basic debugging, testing, and performance improvements Maintain proper technical documentation Collaborate with team members to deliver tasks within project timelines

Annual Leave Medical and Hospitalisation Leave EPF SOCSO EIS Annual Bonus Company Trip 5 Working Days
